name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
July 20, 2009
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: May 18
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting the name of James "Jim" Cole as an inductee to the Circle of Honor. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
e.
Report on protocol followed for the recent water main break/boil water notice in the area south of Pacific Coast Highway. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report recommending waiver of bidding requirements and purchase of radio read water meter receivers and software for $16,550. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
g.
Report recommending waiver of bidding requirements and purchase of two way radio system and software upgrade for a cost not to exceed $7,000. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
h.
Report submitting resolution declaring opposition to the persecution of Falun Gong practitioners in the People's Republic of China. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report recommending acceptance of sanitary sewers and release of bond for a six single family development at 26001 Eshelman Avenue and 26004 Avocado Street. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
PUBLIC HEARING
5.
HOTELS/MOTOR INNS IN COMMERCIAL GENERAL ZONE Public hearing on Zone Text Amendment No 2009-02 amending Section 11.1.45.05 to allow hotels and motor inns as a conditionally permitted use in the commercial general zone.
Presented by Comm Dev Drtc Sugano.
6.
MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS Public hearing on Code Amendment No 2009-3 amending Chapter 8 of Title VI to make modifications consistent with SB 731 which grants state-certified massage establishments specific exemptions from local laws.
Presented by Comm Dev Drtc Sugano.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
7.
KIMLEY HORN INTEGRATED TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM Report recommending approval of agreement with County of Los Angeles for the implementation of the Kimley Horn Integrated Transportation System (KITS) for the intended reduction of regional and local traffic congestion.
Presented by Comm Svcs Drtc McPherron.
8.
MASS NOTIFICATION SYSTEM Report regarding a mass communication system or reverse 911 as a means of notifying residents of an emergency or critical situation.
Presented by City Mgr Odom.
CLOSED SESSION
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
